The API SLA risk calculation logic passed all tests with a perfect reward score, validating the core weighted-risk assessment implementation.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.82 across 1 trial with zero exceptions. Pytest 8.4.1 confirmed success in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite with a duration of 0.257s. While the logic is reusable, the 4m 50s total runtime suggests potential overhead in the environment setup or data processing that should be monitored.
